name: Lulu
source:
Lulu comes to Mirus Clare Magic Academy to improve upon her skills. However, she does not have an "attribute" unlike other students, so she must partner up with someone in order to gain it.

She admires the magic of her late grandmother and aspires to become a magician, but keeps failing at the actual magic.
Her bright and energetic nature is her greatest asset, and she's generally an extremely positive person.

[spoiler]In "Wand of Fortune II", Lulu has become the first human to possess all the attributes which has impressed all the teachers and she's shown to be more confident in her abilities.

[From [url=http://wand-of-fortune.wikia.com/wiki/Lulu]WOF Wikia[/url]]
